text:
sam: Morning — quick runbook for tomorrow's RFC review. Need to lock author order, confirm who presents, and a backup reviewer. T-minus 24h for pre-reads.

priya: Proposed order (short + followups):
1) rfc-storage-layer — author: priya (10m + 5m Q)
2) rfc-routing-fallbacks — author: marta (12m + 8m Q)
3) rfc-kv-cache-shapes — author: jordan (8m + 7m Q)

Can we keep it to 45m total.

jordan: I can be backup reviewer for any slot. I'm out 11:15–12:00 but fine otherwise. :+1:

marta: I can present routing-fallbacks. prefer to go second.

sam: Great. Agenda draft: 
- 0:00 — quick housekeeping & objectives (sam, 2m)
- 0:02 — priya (rfc-storage-layer, 10m)
- 0:12 — marta (rfc-routing-fallbacks, 12m)
- 0:24 — jordan (rfc-kv-cache-shapes, 8m)
- 0:32 — open followups / triage (13m)
- 0:45 — action items & owners (3m)

Pre-read window: please finish reads by 09:00 tomorrow. Link to collated pre-reads: https://redwood.internal/docs/rfc-review-prereads (permissions: eng-team).

Pre-read checklist (please paste feedback as comments in the doc or add a short thread):
```
- 1) High-level agree/disagree (+1/-1)
- 2) Major concerns (security/perf/ops)
- 3) Suggested alternatives (if any)
- 4) Will this block shipping? (yes/no)
```

lee: FYI I need to swap — can I go last instead of third? I have a 10:30 sync that might run over.

priya: swapping jordan<->lee ok? jordan, can you take slot 3 instead and lee move to 3rd?

jordan: I can do slot 3 as long as start isn't delayed. I'll be there.

sam: OK final order: priya, marta, jordan -> followups -> wrap. I'm adding reviewers: sam (lead), priya (secondary), jordan (backup). If someone else wants to call an objection, please raise it now. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "RFC Review — 45m" tomorrow 09:30–10:15 (eng). Attendees: sam, priya, marta, jordan, lee. Link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/event/12345

marta: small ask — can we reserve the first 2 minutes for context on current perf numbers? will show one slide.

sam: yes — slotting updated. Added 2m context to top.

priya: final roster in doc and I added 2 quick comments to rfc-storage-layer pre-read.

sam: perfect. Reminder ping at 08:45 tomorrow and a final short checklist 15m before. React with :thumbsup: when you’ve read pre-reads.

lee: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks — see you tomorrow.
